messages:
maria.k: FYI — NYX Data sent an invoice but there is no PO on it. Invoice ID NYX-2026-043, amount $12,540. Vendor attached PDF: https://files.redwood/nyx/NYX-2026-043.pdf

samir: tagging @jess-finops — do we have a standing PO for NYX subscriptions or should this be a one-off?

jess-finops: We have a blanket PO (4001) for 'data subscriptions' but AP matching failed because vendor name doesn't match our vendor record. Looks like invoice says "NyxData Inc." vs our vendor record "NYX DATA LLC".

kevin.p: I remember a spend request for NYX last month but procurement never issued a PO. I can re-open the PR and request PO generation.

maria.k: Vendor emailed: "please advise — we need confirmation or payment hold will be placed." They noted account code `DATA-SUBS`. Can we provide a temporary approval?

jess-finops: We can't pay without PO for corporate card charges > $10k unless it's pre-approved. Two options: 1) vendor reissues invoice with PO, 2) procurement issues PO now and we route for approver.

samir: Option 2 preferred if procurement can generate today. We have capex window open. GL code should be `6002` (SaaS platforms).

kevin.p: Created PO draft 4872 in procurement portal and attached link: https://proc.redwood/purchase/4872 — assigned approver @cecilia-ops. Marked as expedited and added vendor clarification.

jess-finops: Thanks Kevin. I've also placed a payment hold in AP and flagged the invoice as high priority. Approvals-bot, can you confirm hold?

approvals-bot: Payment hold placed on invoice NYX-2026-043 by jess-finops at 2026-07-14 09:12 UTC. Matching attempt: FAILED — reason: vendor name mismatch. Suggested action: vendor reissue OR manual PO link.

maria.k: I'll forward the PO draft link to the vendor and ask them to either 1) include PO #4872 on a reissued invoice or 2) confirm vendor name to match our record. Sending now.

jess-finops: Once vendor sends corrected invoice, AP can match and queue for payment. If vendor refuses, procurement will route PO and we can process as one-off with manager approval.

kevin.p: Update: Cecilia approved PO 4872 at 11:03. I've set the PO to bill-to `data-team@redwood`. Procurement notes added: "NYX vendor name discrepancy resolved per vendor email 11:01".

approvals-bot: PO 4872 status: APPROVED by cecilia-ops at 2026-07-14 11:03 UTC. AP matching will retry automatically.

maria.k: Vendor just uploaded corrected PDF with PO 4872 at 11:14. Forwarding to AP. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

jess-finops: Confirmed — AP matched invoice to PO 4872 and scheduled payment run on next cycle. Closing loop. I'll leave a note in the vendor file to standardize name as `NYX DATA LLC` to avoid future failures.

maria.k: Great — please update the GL coding to `6002` when posting. I'll follow up if payment doesn't clear by Friday.
